verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents an official CLI usable from terminals, coding agents, and cron, with stable --json output for scripting, meaningful exit codes for automation, and CI-friendly token auth via FORELOOP_TOKEN — all hallmarks of an agentic/AI-native CLI design. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the CLI beyond first-party docs, and no mention of a package registry install method for the CLI itself.
